title: canonical-terminology-alignment
outOfScope: Provider configuration, release publication, and historical archived Work Items are excluded.
Calibration profile storage remains compatible; this Work Item only makes its distinction from governance profiles explicit.

sources.reason: User-required canonical governance and status terms.

rawUserRequest: WI-14 canonical-terminology-alignment: unify light, standard, strict, green, yellow, red, and unknown across machine terminology and multilingual mappings.

declaredIntent.summary: Establish canonical governance and human-status terminology without conflating the separate calibration profile domain.

riskAssessment.reason: Canonicalization must not turn the calibration-specific lite profile into a governance profile.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: User supplied the canonical term set and authorized governed writes.

preReviewWarnings: Verify governance light and calibration lite remain distinct semantic domains.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A canonical terminology registry defines governance profile terms light, standard, strict and human status terms green, yellow, red, unknown.
The registry explicitly distinguishes governance light from calibration lite and rejects invalid terms for each domain.
Focused tests verify canonical values, semantic-domain separation, and status-to-color mapping.
Glossary and reference documentation describe the canonical mapping without rewriting archived artifacts.
guidelines: New terminology APIs must be documented and tested.
Do not conflate governance and calibration vocabulary.

intent.problem: Governance, status, and calibration vocabulary is currently distributed across scripts and documentation, making semantic drift and mistaken global replacement plausible.
constraints: Governance profiles are exactly light, standard, strict.
Human status colors are exactly green, yellow, red, unknown.
Calibration lite is a distinct compatibility domain.
intent.rationale: A small canonical registry makes machine validation and human reporting use the same explicit meanings.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Only light, standard, strict are governance profiles.
Calibration lite remains valid but is not a governance profile.
green, yellow, red, unknown have stable machine and display semantics.
